sources.quote: a $2,500 lump sum to the estate, with a $2,500 top-up for deaths since January 2025 where the deceased never drew a CPP pension and left no eligible survivor
sources.title: Death Benefit - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: The CPP death benefit is a one-time payment, payable to the estate or other eligible individuals. For deaths occurring on or after January 1, 2025, the estate of CPP contributors who die before collecting their retirement or disability pension and leave no spouse or common-law partner will receive a top-up of $2,500 to the existing death benefit of $2,500 (for a total of $5,000).

sources.quote: require operators who promote or sell licensed services through a website to post a free, printable copy of that price list in a clearly visible place on the site
sources.title: Registrar’s Directive: Price list disclosure on websites - Bereavement Authority of Ontario
sources.evidence: Ontario Regulation 30/11 section 68(3) requires that every operator who maintains or makes use of a website to promote the sale or provision of a licensed supply or service or to enter into a contract shall ensure that the operator's price list is available, without charge, in a printable form in a clearly visible place on the website.

sources.quote: the 2024 amendments narrowed what you may add after a headline price to charges imposed by legislation, such as sales tax
sources.title: Guide to the June 2024 amendments to the Competition Act
sources.evidence: The June 2024 amendments clarify that it is misleading to omit mandatory fees from advertised prices, unless those fees are imposed by government on purchasers, such as sales tax. The amendments exclude only charges or fees that represent an amount imposed by or under an Act of Parliament or the legislature of a province.

sources.quote: Review-gating, asking only the families you know were happy, breaches Google's review policy
sources.publisher: Google (Maps User Generated Content Policy Help)
sources.title: Prohibited & restricted content - Maps User Generated Content Policy Help
sources.evidence: Merchants should not discourage or prohibit negative reviews, or selectively solicit positive reviews from customers. When soliciting reviews, merchants should not require or pressure users to leave ratings or write reviews while on the premises.

sources.quote: Google requires listings at real, staffed locations
sources.title: Business eligibility and ownership guidelines - Google Business Profile Help
sources.evidence: To qualify for a Business Profile, a business must make in-person contact with customers during its stated hours. If you serve customers at your address, your business location should be staffed by your team and able to receive customers during its stated hours; service-area businesses can't list a virtual office unless that office is staffed during business hours.

sources.quote: in Quebec a funeral services business licence under the Funeral Operations Act, issued as a separate extract for each funeral facility
sources.title: A-5.02 - Funeral Operations Act
sources.evidence: A funeral services business licence specifies the funeral services the licensee is authorized to provide and the funeral facilities the licensee is authorized to operate. Santé Québec issues an extract of the funeral services business licence for each funeral facility where the licensee is authorized to provide funeral services.
